potential_false_negatives.note: recorded as cut on the first screen, but the blind scorer puts them at or above the advance bar. VMD was then deep-scored blind on the full six measures: 76, tier-2 grade, gate pass, which CONFIRMS the false negative. It sits in data/rigor/judgment_queue.json for the monthly run; the frozen vintages keep the cut so the forward test prices the miss.

reverse_disagreements.note: recorded at or above the bar, blind scorer well below. IRS at recorded 42 contradicts the engine's own industry table, which prices real-estate rent extraction at need 8; the anomaly looks like an error in the recorded score, not in the blind one.

estimated_fn_rate.basis: 1 of the 16 sampled hard cuts (stages 0 and 2) across two pre-registered batches; batch 2 surfaced zero new false negatives and agreed with the recorded scores to 2.6 points of 50
estimated_fn_rate.note: the one flagged name was subsequently confirmed at t2 grade by a full blind six-measure scoring
